a.text: Honest concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to build to 8 first almost guarantees we both get caught short. The reserve only has 4, so only one of us can be safe in round 1. I'd like to agree on something openly rather than race. Any proposal? I won't claim one action and then do another.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Understood. I'll keep our agreement and operate with you. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
